# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: ปุ่มสแกนสินค้าด้วยกล้องบน Navbar

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of user experience and navigation requirements for the navbar camera scanner button
**Created**: 2026-10-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Scope

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact positioning and visibility rules for both desktop and mobile/tablet navbars specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are touch target size requirements explicitly defined with exact pixel dimensions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the behavior for non-POS pages explicitly documented including shift state handling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are visual and auditory feedback requirements documented for successful scans? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]

## Visual Hierarchy & Elderly-Friendly Standards

- [ ] CHK005 Is the button contrast ratio quantified according to WCAG AA/Elderly-Friendly standards? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Constitution §6.5]
- [ ] CHK006 Are active and pressed interaction state requirements consistently defined? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification define icon and label sizing requirements for mobile navigation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for devices lacking camera hardware? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Are fallback requirements specified when camera permissions are denied? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are debounce timing requirements defined to prevent duplicate rapid scans? [Clarity, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements specified for handling unknown barcodes? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined when the scanner is triggered before an active shift exists? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003]

## Measurability & Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CHK013 Can the scan response time target (< 1.5 seconds) be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK014 Can the touch target compliance (100% >= 48x48px) be objectively verified across viewports? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK015 Are acceptance criteria for single-tap entry into camera scanning testable across all pages? [Testability, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
